en: Color postcard showing a mountain resort town with red‑roofed villas and hotels scattered on green slopes under a high, snowy ridge. A tall fir tree stands in the foreground. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian airmail stamp depicting cosmonaut Andrian (A.) Nicolaev, a PREDEAL postmark, and a multilingual caption mentioning Valea Prahovei (Prahova Valley) – Predeal.
